ios.desc:
Turn workout videos into real workouts you can follow

You save workout videos every day — on Instagram, TikTok, or Facebook.
But when it's time to actually work out? Everything falls apart.

FitSaver is a workout organizer built to turn saved workout videos into a clear, trackable fitness routine you can actually follow at the gym or at home.

The problem FitSaver solves
Most people consume tons of workout videos, but struggle to use them consistently.

Saved videos end up scattered across:
Instagram saves
Facebook saved folder
TikTok favorites
Notes apps
Screenshots and bookmarks

At the gym or during a home workout, this leads to:
Forgetting exercise order
Losing rest times mid-set
Constant app switching
No way to track progress

FitSaver fixes that.

What FitSaver does

FitSaver transforms workout videos into structured, usable routines:
Save workouts directly from Instagram or TikTok or Facebook links
Convert videos into clean, step-by-step gym routines
Add exercises, sets, reps, and rest timers
Follow your daily workout without switching apps
Track completed workouts and milestones over time

Whether you're building a fitness routine, planning a gym routine, or organizing a home workout, FitSaver keeps everything in one place.

Built for real workouts

FitSaver is not another coaching app or generic tracker.

It's an exercise planner designed for people who already follow creators and want to turn inspiration into consistency.

Use it to:
Organize workout videos you already love
Plan workouts ahead of time
Stay focused during training
Build a repeatable workout habit

Perfect for you if you:
Save workouts but never reuse them
Follow fitness creators on Instagram or TikTok or Facebook
Want a simple exercise planner



FREE FEATURES
Import up to 5 workouts
Create workout collections
Browse and organize saved workouts
Track basic progress
Follow daily workout routines

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION (In-App Purchase)
Unlimited workout imports
Advanced workout scheduling
Detailed streak tracking
Priority support
Access to all future features

Pricing
• Monthly: $3.99/month
• Annual: $29.99/year
• Lifetime: $99.99/one-time

Subscription required for unlimited imports and advanced features. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
